subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ae1971c42bae5d2468c0030b327e14574e825e2171357d0979ec0d5a9355fd5.png]
solution: The logic followed here is: 1) First box series → 1st and 3rd element in first column and 2nd element in third column shift clockwise. 1st and 3rd element in third column and 2nd element in first column shift anticlockwise. Center element is replaced by new element.
